name: MeetRox
subcategory: AI conversation intelligence and sales coaching
tagline: Sales conversation analysis, AI coaching, scorecards and CRM autofill

pricing.basis: Custom quote; no public per-seat price verified
pricing.notes: A verified public monthly price was not found.

verdictSummary: You can build the useful core in a weekend: upload sales recordings or transcripts, transcribe them, score them against a playbook and generate evidence-backed coaching. The complete product is not a weekend project. MeetRox captures meetings, calls and WhatsApp conversations across multiple providers, ties them to CRM records and operates managed coaching and autofill workflows. That integration and ingestion reliability is the hard part, not the summary prompt.
coreLoopDIY: Upload a sales recording or transcript, transcribe it, evaluate it against a configurable scorecard and export a coaching summary.
diyTimeEstimate: weekend MVP with uploaded recordings; multi-month integration parity
requirements: OpenAI transcription and LLM API keys
Audio or text transcripts obtained with appropriate consent
Optional CRM API credentials for a single connector
whatYouLose: Automatic capture across WhatsApp, telephony and meeting providers
Broad maintained CRM integrations and dependable record matching
moatNotes: Third-party access to voice and WhatsApp data, continuous connector upkeep, and reliable CRM synchronization are harder than LLM analysis.
whyPeopleStillPay: A manager wants every conversation captured, linked to the right deal and scored consistently without maintaining fragile telephony and CRM connectors. MeetRox packages that reliability with ongoing team coaching and support.

priorArt.desc: Automation building block for importing and routing CRM events

prompt:
Build a small sales conversation intelligence app using Next.js, TypeScript, SQLite, and the OpenAI API.
Use a single-user local dashboard; no SaaS subscription or team authentication.
Create a page to upload MP3, WAV, MP4 or plain-text transcripts.
Store original files and structured conversation records locally.
Transcribe uploaded audio using the OpenAI transcription API.
Allow the user to enter deal name, seller, company and conversation date.
Create a configurable sales scorecard with five criteria and weights.
Analyze each transcript against the scorecard using an LLM.
For each criterion, show score, supporting transcript quote and confidence.
Extract objections, pain points, competitors and next steps.
Generate a concise coach summary with three evidence-based improvements.
Show conversation history, seller averages and score trends.
Support CSV export for scores and action items.
Add an optional HubSpot sync using a token provided in .env.
Match a deal by manually supplied CRM ID, not fuzzy contact matching.
Never auto-update CRM fields without explicit confirmation.
Handle transcription errors and rate limits with visible retry controls.
Include sample fixtures and unit tests for score calculation.
Do not implement WhatsApp interception, telephony recording or meeting bots.
Do not promise enterprise certifications or uptime.
Keep provider keys in .env and include a README with consent and privacy notes.
